inventory.system: PGIR semantic public API and canonical structured-text IR
inventory.finding: SemanticPublicAPI@1 (pgir-semantic-api/v1) is a versioned discovery surface. compile delegates to TypedDeonticCanonicalCompiler.compile under CanonicalStructuredTextCompiler@1; decompile delegates to SourceWithheldCanonicalDecompiler. Persistent identities are CIDv1. This is reusable semantic authority for structured-text/legal IR. It is not a current-tree Python AST/CFG/data-flow compiler or M1 source linker. CanonicalCodeIR@1 remains absent from all four nested repositories.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse as datasets-owned semantic API and IR contracts. Do not fork a second PGIR catalog. Python CanonicalCodeIR remains a named follow-on delta.

inventory.authority: ipfs_datasets_py builds identity; ipfs_accelerate_py consumes it; Mcp-Plus-Plus owns wire schema only
inventory.finding: Datasets build_context_pack is the sole production builder (DatasetsContextPackAuthority@0.1). Pack CID derives from schema, interface, repository state, exact source CIDs, capsule CIDs, scanned tree, and freshness; stale, unavailable, and opaque-without-exact-tree cases fail closed. Accelerator semantic_bridge delegates and must not reconstruct packs. CONTEXT_PACK_V01_AUTHORITY is ipfs_datasets_py.proof_context.context_pack. ContextPacker remains a token-budget compatibility surface with V01_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY=False. SemanticCapsuleCompiler@1 (ipfs-datasets.software-contracts.semantic-capsule-compiler@1) is the capsule compiler consumed by packs, not a second ContextPack authority.
inventory.reuse_decision: Consume DatasetsContextPackAuthority@0.1 and the MCP++ v0.1 wire schema. Do not fork a pack builder. Do not promote ContextPacker to production identity authority.

inventory.authority: ipfs_accelerate_py owns routing metrics; ipfs_datasets_py owns compression policy contracts; ipfs_kit_py owns byte/storage compression only
inventory.finding: Accelerator compression-metrics@1 is unavailable-aware and supports paired raw/semantic ContextPack measurement. Datasets CompressionPolicy is a semantic-governor policy contract, not a Python minifier. Kit CompressionProfile is byte/storage encoding. None of these is a ProofCarryingSemanticProjection or M1 lossless structural projection.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse governor metrics and datasets policy contracts for routing accounting. Do not treat kit encoding as semantic minification.

inventory.system: Proof-carrying artifact and immutable proof bytes
inventory.authority: ipfs_datasets_py validates semantic proof lineage; ipfs_kit_py verifies exact bytes and CIDv1 storage
inventory.finding: ProofCarryingArtifact@1 binds mandatory semantic, contract, abstract, proof, test, static, security, policy, and authority lineage and rejects forged CIDs, stale roots, missing lineage, omitted compact checks, lineage mismatch, and producer flags. Kit put/get helpers reject byte/CID disagreement and require CIDv1 base32. Kit does not judge semantic soundness.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse datasets proof-carrying artifacts and kit immutable storage. Do not create a competing proof store.

inventory.finding: LogicSourceMap@1 wraps syntax-source-map/v1 token/trivia maps and is deterministic and versioned. Legal-IR SourceMapEntry travels beside source-withheld canonical IR and is CIDv1-bound. Neither map is exact current Python AST node and mutable-span identity for M1 linking. No PCSM SourceLinkReceipt or current-tree Python source-map CID exists at this head.
inventory.reuse_decision: Reuse syntax-core and legal-IR map contracts as components. Do not treat them as PCSM M1 Python source-link receipts.

relevant_controls: ContextPack CID derives from exact source and scanned-tree inputs.
Kit verifies supplied bytes against CIDv1 base32 identity.

PGIR compile/decompile persistent identities are CIDv1.
